# Radar

Radar is a full-stack location infrastructure platform offering SDKs and APIs for geofencing, location tracking, geocoding, search, routing, and maps.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/radar/.

## Actions

- **Autocomplete Address or Place** (read-only): Autocomplete partial addresses and place names based on relevance and proximity.
- **Create Trip**: Create a new trip.
- **Forward Geocode** (read-only): Convert an address into geographic coordinates.
- **Get Context for Location** (read-only): Retrieve context for a given location.
- **Get Geofence** (read-only): Retrieve a geofence by radar id or tag/externalid.
- **Get Places Settings** (read-only): Retrieve current places settings for your radar project.
- **Get Trip** (read-only): Retrieve a trip by id or externalid.
- **List Beacons** (read-only): List all beacons sorted by creation date.
- **List Geofences** (read-only): List all geofences sorted by updated time.
- **List Trips** (read-only): List all trips, sorted by updated time.
- **List Users** (read-only): List radar users sorted by update time.
- **Reverse Geocode** (read-only): Convert geographic coordinates to structured addresses.
- **Search Geofences** (read-only): Search for geofences near a given location.
- **Search Places Near Location** (read-only): Search for places near given coordinates.
- **Track Location Update**: Track a user's location update.
- **Update Trip**: Update a trip.
- **Upsert Geofence**: Create or update a geofence by tag and externalid.
- **Delete Geofence**: Delete a geofence by id.
- **Delete Trip**: Delete a trip by its radar id or external id.
- **Get Users in Geofence** (read-only): Retrieve users currently within a specific geofence.
- **IP Geocode** (read-only): Geocode an ip address to city, state, and country.
- **List Events** (read-only): List events.
- **Route Distance** (read-only): Compute distance and travel time between origins and destinations.
- **Search Users Near Location** (read-only): Search for users near a location.
